name: terminal-clear
notes: Ctrl+L terminal-style clear (jcode parity): the mock script's content settles first (all events buffer before the run loop drains, then keys replay), so the cleared frame must show a zero-height transcript chunk with the composer at top and NONE of the transcript text. Nothing is deleted: any new output (transcript-version bump), streaming, or scrolling up ends the state and restores the full layout.
